biome.name: Grassland
biome.description: Highveld temperate grassland, summer rainfall, cold frosty winters
biome.soilType: Red/yellow apedal soils, moderate depth, clay-rich on Highveld
biome.waterStrategy: Heavy summer thunderstorms (short, intense). Keyline design on all slopes — angle swales 1:1000 off true contour to move water across hillside. Winter dry → storage essential. Roof: 1m² = 1L per 1mm rain.
biome.soilStrategy: Often compacted by livestock. Subsoil aeration before earthworks. Oats/vetch winter cover crops. pH usually 5.5–6.5, add agricultural lime if below 5.5. Build OM with compost + biochar.

phases.title: Verify, Set Out & Make Safe
tasks: Walk the boundary and peg every corner against the traced line before anything else.
Set out each element with pegs and string at its plan size — check the spacing on the ground, not on the screen.
Confirm buried services (water, power, septic) with the owner and mark them on the ground.
Mark a no-dig strip around the house footings and the tank stand.
Agree where materials and spoil may be stacked — not on the driveway.
phases.holdPoint: Hold Point A: Boundary pegs, marked services and the set-out agreed with the owner on site before any ground is broken.

phases.title: Safe Access & Water Spine
tasks: Cut and compact the paths so every work area is reachable with a barrow.
Set every tank on a level, compacted base before you plumb it — a full tank cannot be moved.
phases.holdPoint: Hold Point B: Pressure and leak test the main line before backfilling any trench.

phases.title: Earthworks & Soil Building
tasks: Peg the contour with an A-frame or water level before you cut anything — eyeballed levels are how swales become drains.
Dig the swales on true contour and spread the spoil onto the downhill berm.
phases.holdPoint: Hold Point C: Levels re-checked along every swale and bank, and the bank planted, before the first big rain.

phases.title: Beds, Drip & Working Infrastructure
tasks: Build the beds at their plan size and fill with compost — no bed wider than two arm-lengths.
Site the compost bays within barrow distance of both the kitchen and the beds.
phases.holdPoint: Hold Point D: Run the drip at working pressure and check every emitter before mulching over the lines.

phases.title: Perennials & Guilds
tasks: Plant at the onset of the summer rains (Oct–Nov) — never into dry soil.
Dig the tree pits at the pegged positions and backfill with compost and topsoil.
Mulch every tree thick and wide, and keep the mulch off the stem.
Stake and guard the young trees against wind and browsing.
Plan the first two summers' watering: ~791 mm a year does not establish trees unaided.
phases.holdPoint: Hold Point E: Water tested and reaching every planting pit before the first tree goes in the ground.

phases.title: Commissioning & Handover
tasks: Snag the build against this sheet: every hold point signed, every leak found and fixed.
Walk the owner through the valves, the drip zones and every hold point on this sheet.
Photograph each element against this sheet as the as-built record.
phases.holdPoint: Hold Point F: Every earlier hold point signed off and the as-built record handed over before the job is closed.

siteRules: Keep the driveway open at all times — no spoil, pipe or materials stored on it.
No excavation within 1 m of the house footings or a tank stand.
Test the water before it goes onto food beds or into a trough.
Barrier or backfill every open excavation at the end of each working day.
Work inside the pegged boundary — agree anything on the line with the neighbour first.
Confirm every dimension on site — the plan is the intent, the ground is the truth.

zu.note: Izilinganiso zesikhathi eside zale ndawo, akusona isibikezelo. Noma yimuphi unyaka ungaba nemvula eningi noma ube womile kakhulu kunalokhu.
zu.alt: Imvula ngenyanga: 791 mm ngonyaka; enemvula kakhulu Jan 134 mm, eyome kakhulu May 12 mm. Inyanga efudumele kakhulu Jan 22.7 °C, ebanda kakhulu Jul 11.5 °C.

zu.title: Ilanga, umoya nomthambeka
zu.note: INyakatho iphezulu; uphawu lwendlu yile ndawo. Izindlela zelanga zibalwa ngokwe-latitude. Izimpawu ezinemidwa ziyiphethini yesifunda, aziyona imilinganiso: ziqinisekise ngalokho wena nomakhelwane enikubonayo.
zu.source: Ilanga: kubalwe nge-latitude 27.73° S. Umoya nomlilo: iphethini yesifunda (kzn-coastal). Umthambeka: imodeli yokuphakama.
zu.alt: Umdwebo wamasekta. Ilanga lasehlobo: liphuma ESE, lishona WSW, 86° ngaphezu komkhathizwe emini, enyakatho. Ilanga lasebusika: liphuma ENE, lishona WNW, 39° ngaphezu komkhathizwe emini, enyakatho. Summer cooling wind: uvela e NE, Sep–Mar (iphethini yesifunda). Cold front — driving rain: uvela e SW, Mar–Aug (iphethini yesifunda). Berg wind: uvela e NW, May–Aug, episodic (iphethini yesifunda). Umlilo kungenzeka ufike uvela e NW. Winter grassfire / ember risk follows the dry, hot berg wind, not the cooling summer wind. Umhlaba ubonakala ucishe ube yisicaba, ngakho akukho ndlela yokwehla edwetshiwe.

zu.title: Ukulandelana komsebenzi
zu.note: Ukulandelana nobude obulinganiselwe besigaba ngasinye, kubalwe kulokho okusemklamweni ogciniwe. Amaviki ayisiqondiso sokuhlela, akusona isithembiso: isimo sezulu, imali nabasebenzi kuzowashintsha. Ukulandelana akufanele kushintshe.
